newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B index down on poor interim results.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B index down on poor interim results.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended down on Friday on overseas selling in stocks which have issued poor results, brokers said.
The index shed 0.236 point or 0.46 percent to 51.409, on volume of 10.4 million shares worth $4.3 million. Of 41 B shares, 35 traded with 16 down, 10 flat and nine up.
Brokers said that too many listed firms published poor interim results, which depressed the market.
"Investors have no interest in buying stocks with poor results at current levels, and sales of these shares pushed the index down," one broker said.
"The market will rebound next week, after most negative factors have been digested," a second broker said.
Shanghai Vacuum Electron Device was the biggest loser on poor interim results, plunging $0.018 or 11.24 percent to $0.142 on volume of 152,300 shares.
Shanghai Huili Building Materials traded the most on heavy overseas selling, falling $0.004 or 2.04 percent to $0.192 on volume of 2.5 million shares.
The Shanghai A share index rallied in active trading, but it is expected to meet resistance around 850 points in the next few days, brokers said.
The A index ended up 22.882 points or 2.78 percent at 847.210 points, on volume of 425.3 million shares worth 3.5 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 index gained 62.096 points or 2.94 percent to 2174.565 points.
Tonghua Dongbao Medicines was the star, soaring 1.84 yuan or 14.16 percent to 14.83 yuan, on volume of 7.6 million shares.
